让 我 看看.es: déjame mirar; déjame echar un vistazo
让 我 看看.en: Let me look; let me take a look
让 我 看看.consejo: - It indicates who will do the action.

让 他 进来.consejo: The person shows up after the day.

让 我们 一起 去.consejo: - Introduce those who will do the action.

我 让 他 来.es: hago que él venga; dejo que venga
我 让 他 来.en: I make him come; I let him come.

你 让 他 进来 吧.es: deja que él entre, por favor
你 让 他 进来 吧.consejo: - Introduce the person who will do the action.

texto: **让 + persona + verbo** means «let someone do something» or ask you to do so. You can combine it with a proposal: **让我看看** = let me look at it; **让他进来吧** = let me enter.
To close a suggestion with a choice, **还是…吧** presents the option that seems best.
